brief:
Egypt's President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi has rejected any displacement of Palestinians from Gaza, Al Jazeera English reported. The statement came after Israel's defence minister pledged to remove Palestinians from the besieged Strip, signaling a potential escalation in the conflict and raising concerns over mass forced migration.

El-Sisi's position reflects Egypt's longstanding opposition to policies that would transfer Palestinian refugees across its border, a core issue in regional diplomacy given Egypt's shared border with Gaza.
dek: Israel’s defence minister has pledged to remove Palestinians from the besieged Strip.
title: El-Sisi rejects Israeli plan to displace Palestinians from Gaza
